sources.entry: Hugging Face - The AI community building the future with open-source AI technologies.

summary.name: Hugging Face
summary.one_liner: Hugging Face is an AI community and platform for hosting, discovering, and collaborating on open machine learning models, datasets, and applications.
use_cases: Find and download pretrained AI models
Host and share machine learning models and datasets
Build and showcase ML demos in Spaces
Access many hosted models through a single API
Rent GPU compute to deploy models
Fine-tune language models with open-source libraries
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Hugging Face as a hub where users host and collaborate on public models, datasets, and applications (Spaces) across text, image, video, audio, and 3D modalities. It lists an open-source software stack, including Transformers, Diffusers, Safetensors, Tokenizers, TRL, PEFT, Datasets, Accelerate, and Text Generation Inference. It offers an Inference Providers API described as giving access to 45,000+ models through one unified API with no service fees. It also sells paid Team & Enterprise plans and GPU compute for Inference Endpoints and Spaces.
notable: Hosts public models, datasets, and Spaces apps across text, image, video, audio, and 3D
Inference Providers API with access to 45,000+ models through one unified API
Maintains open-source libraries such as Transformers, Diffusers, and PEFT
caveats: GPU compute starts at $0.60/hour, so heavier use costs money
Page mainly markets the platform; specific free-tier limits are not stated
